# v2.55-dev Release Notes

## Fixed: mobile Safari logged you out on refresh

### Fixed

- **Refreshing a page on an iPhone/iPad (Safari) no longer bounces you back to
  the login screen.** The session cookie was set with `SameSite=Strict`, which
  iOS Safari withholds on address-bar reloads and pull-to-refresh — so a mobile
  refresh arrived without the session and got redirected to login. The cookie is
  now `SameSite=Lax`, so it rides along on page reloads (matching desktop
  behaviour) while still protecting against cross-site request forgery.

### Notes

- No database migration and no configuration required.
- You stay signed in across refreshes on mobile just like on desktop; existing
  sessions pick up the new cookie setting automatically on the next request.
